configurationFields.label: Server Map/Branch
configurationFields.description: Sets the server map to use, which determines the branch to install. NOTE: Update the server after changing this setting!

configurationFields.label: Servername
configurationFields.description: The name of the server as it appears publicly

configurationFields.label: Set MultiHome IP
configurationFields.description: If needed, set a private or public IP to bind the server to, or 0.0.0.0 for all IPs

configurationFields.label: Spielerlimit
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of players that may connect to the server at one time. More than 100 not recommended

configurationFields.label: Require Server Password
configurationFields.description: If enabled, a password will be required to join the server. Specify the password under Server Password

configurationFields.label: Serverpasswort
configurationFields.description: Sets the password to connect to the server. Default is a strong random password. Require Server Password must be enabled. Even if Require Server Password is disabled, this setting must have a value for the server to appear in the server browser

configurationFields.label: Server Admins
configurationFields.description: Specifies the [Steam64 IDs](https://steamid.io/) of server admins. One line per admin. Format: AdminsSteamIDs=71231XXXXXXXXXXXX

configurationFields.label: Enable Whitelist
configurationFields.description: If set, the server whitelist will be enabled, so that only players whose Steam64 IDs are listed under Whitelisted Players will be able to join the server (in addition to server admins)

configurationFields.label: Whitelisted Players
configurationFields.description: Specifies the [Steam64 IDs](https://steamid.io/) of whitelisted players. One line per player. Format: WhitelistIDs=71231XXXXXXXXXXXX

configurationFields.label: Server VIPs
configurationFields.description: Specifies the [Steam64 IDs](https://steamid.io/) of server VIPs. VIPs can skip the queue if the server is full. One line per VIP. Format: VIPs=71231XXXXXXXXXXXX

configurationFields.label: RCON aktivieren
configurationFields.description: If set, the server's RCON will be enabled. Specify the RCON password under RCON Password

configurationFields.label: RCON-Passwort
configurationFields.description: Sets the password to connect to the server's RCON. Default is a strong, random password

configurationFields.label: Enable Queue Server
configurationFields.description: If enabled, players can queue to join a full server. Requires the Queue Port to be opened

configurationFields.label: Discord Invite URL
configurationFields.description: Sets the invite URL for a Discord server to which players will be taken when clicking on the Discord button in the server

configurationFields.label: Allowed Classes
configurationFields.description: Specifies the names of enabled classes. One line per class. Format: AllowedClasses=Dryosaurus

configurationFields.label: Enable Humans
configurationFields.description: If set, human characters will be enabled on the server

configurationFields.label: Enable Dynamic Weather
configurationFields.description: If set, dynamic weather will be enabled on the server

configurationFields.label: Minimum Weather Variation Interval
configurationFields.description: Sets the minimum interval for how often weather is switched. Dynamic Weather must be enabled

configurationFields.label: Maximum Weather Variation Interval
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum interval for how often weather is switched. Dynamic Weather must be enabled

configurationFields.label: Enable Fall Damage
configurationFields.description: If enabled, falls cause damage

configurationFields.label: Day Length
configurationFields.description: Sets the length of a day

configurationFields.label: Night Length
configurationFields.description: Sets the length of a night

configurationFields.label: Enable Plant Spawning
configurationFields.description: If enabled, plants will be spawned

configurationFields.label: Plant Spawn Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for how many plants to spawn. Higher values = increased plant spawn amount

configurationFields.label: Enable Global Chat
configurationFields.description: If set, global chat will be enabled on the server

configurationFields.label: Spawn AI
configurationFields.description: If set, AI will be spawned on the server

configurationFields.label: AI Spawn Interval
configurationFields.description: Sets how frequently the server checks to spawn new AI. Spawn AI must be enabled

configurationFields.label: Disabled AI Classes
configurationFields.description: Specifies the names of AI classes that should be disabled. One line per class. Format: DisallowedAIClasses=Compsognathus

configurationFields.label: AI Density
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for AI density. Spawn AI must be enabled

configurationFields.label: Enable Migration
configurationFields.description: If set, migration will be enabled, including patrols and mass migrations

configurationFields.label: Species Migration Zone Length
configurationFields.description: Sets how long a species migration zone will last. Enable Migration must be set

configurationFields.label: Enable Mass Migration
configurationFields.description: If set, mass migrations will be enabled

configurationFields.label: Mass Migration Interval
configurationFields.description: Sets how often a new mass migration is set

configurationFields.label: Mass Migration Length
configurationFields.description: Sets how long a mass migration lasts once set

configurationFields.label: Enable Patrol Zones
configurationFields.description: If set, the PatrolZone system will be enabled

configurationFields.label: Enable Diets
configurationFields.description: If set, diets will be enabled

configurationFields.label: Growth Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the universal multiplier for growth. Setting this too high will stop it working - recommendation is no higher than 20

configurationFields.label: Enable Mutations
configurationFields.description: If set, mutations will be enabled on the server. Set Enabled Mutations List as required

configurationFields.label: Enabled Mutations List
configurationFields.description: Specifies the list of all enabled mutations and values. Keep fully commented out to have all mutations enabled. Enabling any mutations means you must include all mutations you would like available on the server (one line per mutation). Note that changing default values may produce unstable gameplay

configurationFields.label: Allow Replay
configurationFields.description: If set, the server's replay system will be enabled. Recording can be started and stopped in-game via the F2 key. Replays must be a minimum of 5 seconds and cannot be viewed until 30 minutes has passed

configurationFields.label: Use Region Spawning
configurationFields.description: If set, the region menu will be enabled when selecting a character

configurationFields.label: Use Region Spawn Cooldown
configurationFields.description: If set, region cooldown will be enabled

configurationFields.label: Region Spawn Cooldown Time
configurationFields.description: Sets the cooldown time period that must pass before a player is able to select the relevant region again. Use Region Spawning and Use Region Spawn Cooldown must be enabled. Adjust the period for your server's timezone offset from UTC (positive or negative)

configurationFields.label: Corpse Decay Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for how fast corpses decay to despawn. Lower = faster
